text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser scores a magnificent 
victory against Daitaku Helios! The two 
exchange promises to battle each other 
once again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, Daitaku Helios even 
invites you to the "Cheer Up Helios Fest"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the Mile CS drew to a close.
